name: W-MATH-027 N02 compile and real screens — NO DEPLOY
on:
  push:
    branches: ['work/W-MATH-027-n02-r1-20261024']
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'e2e/**'
      - '.github/workflows/wmath027-structure-check.yml'
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: wmath027-n02-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  compile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    env:
      CI: 'true'
      CAPTURE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      E2E_USE_PREVIEW: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 11.9.0
          run_install: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run typecheck
      - name: Compile current app immediately after approved patch
        run: |
          pnpm run build
          node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/build-verification.json', JSON.stringify({source_sha:process.env.CAPTURE_SHA,scope:'N02 P-002-N02-R1',publication:false}))"
      - name: Actual source, old Q01-Q05 and approved action-count invariants
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'JS'
          import { createServer } from 'vite'
          import { writeFileSync, unlinkSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
          import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
          const path = 'src/data/textbook/math/numbers/n02BaselineForCheck.ts'
          writeFileSync(path, execFileSync('git', ['show', 'f3c69618d5f97cf235d2f0d0d9256f33056e9525:src/data/textbook/math/numbers/n02Lesson.ts']))
          const server = await createServer({ server: { middlewareMode: true } })
          try {
            const now = await server.ssrLoadModule('/src/data/textbook/math/numbers/n02Lesson.ts')
            const old = await server.ssrLoadModule('/' + path)
            const math = await server.ssrLoadModule('/src/data/textbook/math/index.ts')
            assert.deepEqual(now.mathNumbersN02Unit.sections[0].items.slice(0, 5), old.mathNumbersN02Unit.sections[0].items.slice(0, 5))
            const oldFlow = old.mathNumbersN02Unit.sections[0].readingFlow
            const newFlow = now.mathNumbersN02Unit.sections[0].readingFlow
            const boundary = oldFlow.findIndex(x => x.id === 'paragraph-sum-coeff')
            assert.deepEqual(newFlow.slice(0, boundary), oldFlow.slice(0, boundary))
            assert.equal(Object.keys(now.n02SourceToItemIds).length, 12)
            assert.equal(now.mathNumbersN02Unit.sections[0].items.length, 15)
            const chapter = math.mathTextbookUnits.filter(u => u.chapter?.chapterId === 'math-ch01-numbers-expressions')
            assert.equal(chapter.length, 16)
            assert.equal(chapter.reduce((n,u) => n + u.sections.flatMap(s=>s.items).length, 0), 318)
            const catalog = await server.ssrLoadModule('/src/data/textbook/math/mathCatalog.ts')
            const counts = catalog.mathTextbookTopics.filter(t=>t.chapterId==='math-ch01-numbers-expressions').map(t=>t.unitIds.reduce((n,id)=>n+chapter.find(u=>u.unitId===id).sections.flatMap(s=>s.items).length,0))
            assert.deepEqual(counts, [125,77,116])
            mkdirSync('e2e-evidence/wmath027-n02', {recursive:true})
            writeFileSync('e2e-evidence/wmath027-n02/source-invariants.json', JSON.stringify({source:process.env.CAPTURE_SHA,baseline:'f3c69618d5f97cf235d2f0d0d9256f33056e9525',units:16,originalQuestions:233,actions:318,counts,unchangedQ01Q05:true,status:'PASS'},null,2))
          } finally { await server.close(); unlinkSync(path) }
          JS
      - name: Math, schema and all progress regression tests
        run: pnpm exec vitest run src/data/textbook/math src/domain/textbook.test.ts src/domain/textbookSchema.test.ts
      - name: Install Japanese font and browser
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y fonts-noto-cjk
          pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Compiled-app real screens, migration, wrong/hint/reload and original routes
        run: pnpm exec playwright test e2e/wmath027-three-themes.spec.ts e2e/numbers-next-batch.spec.ts e2e/numbers-catalog-publish.spec.ts --project=mobile-chromium --project=desktop-chromium --workers=2
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: wmath027-n02-compiled-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            e2e-evidence/wmath027-n02/
            e2e-evidence/wmath027/
            test-results/
            dist/
          retention-days: 7

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test'

const route = (unitId: string) => '/kyotsu-step-web/#/learning/textbook/' + unitId

async function visitClean(page: Page, unitId: string) {
  await page.goto(route(unitId))
  await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear())
  await page.reload()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-reading-flow')).toBeVisible()
}

async function choose(page: Page, id: string, answer: string) {
  const trigger = page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + id)
  await expect(trigger).toBeVisible()
  await trigger.click()
  const panel = page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-' + id)
  await expect(panel).toBeVisible()
  await panel.getByRole('button', { name: answer, exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-' + id)).toBeVisible()
}

async function mobileLayoutCheck(page: Page) {
  await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
  const viewport = await page.evaluate(() => ({
    content: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,
    client: document.documentElement.clientWidth,
  }))
  expect(viewport.content).toBeLessThanOrEqual(viewport.client + 1)
}

test('N02 review: 12 source questions through 15 local decisions, no forward leakage', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 720 })
  await visitClean(page, 'math-numbers-expressions-n02')
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: '式を整える', exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-current-topic')).toContainText('多項式の整理と加減')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n02-01')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n02-02')).toHaveCount(0)
  const answers: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ['n02-01','3bx'],
    ['n02-02','x^3-ax^2+3bx+5c'],
    ['n02-03','(2y-3,\\ y^2-3y+2)'],
    ['n02-04','x^2+(2y-3)x+(y^2-3y+2)'],
    ['n02-05','0x'],
    ['n02-06','-1'],
    ['n02-r2-q07-x3','1'],
    ['n02-07','-2'],
    ['n02-08','-3'],
    ['n02-r2-q09-a2','-6'],
    ['n02-09','3'],
    ['n02-10','-12'],
    ['n02-r2-q11-sign','+'],
    ['n02-11','-3'],
    ['n02-12','7x^3-12x^2+2x-8'],
  ]
  for (const [id, answer] of answers) {
    await choose(page, id, answer)
    if (id === 'n02-07') await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n02-08')).toBeVisible()
    if (id === 'n02-10') await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n02-r2-q11-sign')).toBeVisible()
  }
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toBeVisible()
  await mobileLayoutCheck(page)
  await page.reload()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toBeVisible()
})

test('N09 review: n=-3 gates original figure, all 14 original plus 4 square decisions and negative fractional parts', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 720 })
  await visitClean(page, 'math-numbers-expressions-n09')
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: '実数を扱う', exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-current-topic')).toContainText('平方根の符号と数直線')
  const originalFigure = page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-n09-f01')
  await expect(originalFigure).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n09-02')).toHaveCount(0)

  const first: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ['n09-01','x=4,\\ -4'],
    ['n09-02','(4,\\ 5)'],
    ['n09-03','4'],
    ['n09-04','(a,\\ -a)'],
    ['n09-05','|a|'],
    ['n09-06','2-\\sqrt5<0'],
    ['n09-07','\\sqrt5-2'],
    ['n09-p001-q08-left-square','1.9881'],
    ['n09-p001-q08-right-square','2.0164'],
    ['n09-p001-q08-lower-sign','<'],
    ['n09-p001-q08-upper-sign','<'],
    ['n09-08','1.41^2=1.9881<2<2.0164=1.42^2'],
    ['n09-09','1.41<\\sqrt2<1.42'],
  ]
  for (const [id, answer] of first) await choose(page, id, answer)
  await expect(originalFigure).toHaveCount(0)

  // Deliberately wrong flooring must not expose image, alt, or Q11.
  await page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n09-10').click()
  const panel = page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-n09-10')
  await panel.getByRole('button', { name: '-2', exact: true }).click()
  await expect(originalFigure).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n09-11')).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n09-10')).toBeVisible()

  await choose(page, 'n09-10', '-3')
  await expect(originalFigure).toBeVisible()
  await expect(originalFigure.locator('img')).toHaveJSProperty('complete', true)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n09-11')).toBeVisible()

  const last: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ['n09-11','-3+0.9'],
    ['n09-12','3<\\sqrt{10}<4'],
    ['n09-13','-4<-\\sqrt{10}<-3'],
    ['n09-14','\\begin{aligned}\\sqrt{10}&:(3,\\sqrt{10}-3)\\\\-\\sqrt{10}&:(-4,4-\\sqrt{10})\\end{aligned}'],
  ]
  for (const [id, answer] of last) await choose(page, id, answer)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toBeVisible()
  await mobileLayoutCheck(page)
  await page.reload()
  await expect(originalFigure).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toBeVisible()
})

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import katex from 'katex'
import { isTextbookAnswerCorrect } from '../../../../domain/textbook'
import { normalizeTextbookMath } from '../../../../domain/textbookMath'
import { mathNumbersN01Unit } from './n01Lesson'
import { mathNumbersN02Unit, n02SourceToItemIds } from './n02Lesson'
import { mathNumbersN03Unit } from './n03Lesson'

const section = mathNumbersN02Unit.sections[0]
const blocks = section.readingFlow
const q05 = section.items.find(q => q.id === 'n02-05')!
const q05Index = blocks.findIndex(block =>
  (block.type === 'paragraph' || block.type === 'formula')
  && block.parts.some(part => part.type === 'choice' && part.itemId === 'n02-05'))

describe('W-MATH-010/P-001: N02 missing zero-coefficient TERM', () => {
  it('preserves Q05 exactly during approved Q06-Q12 revision and keeps all 12 source mappings', () => {
    const originalIds = Object.values(n02SourceToItemIds).flat()
    expect(section.items.map(q => q.id)).toEqual(originalIds)
    expect(mathNumbersN02Unit.revision).toBe(2)
    expect(mathNumbersN02Unit.status).toBe('review')
    expect(q05.answer).toBe('0x')
    expect(q05.choices).toEqual(['0x', 'x', '-x', '2x'])
    expect(section.items).toHaveLength(15)
    expect(mathNumbersN01Unit.sections[0].items).toHaveLength(18)
    expect(mathNumbersN03Unit.sections[0].items).toHaveLength(17)
  })

  it('asks for a missing first-degree term rather than only the coefficient', () => {
    expect(q05.prompt).toBe('係数が0の一次項を、Bの式中に補おう。')
    expect(q05.prompt).toContain('一次項')
    expect(q05.prompt).not.toContain('係数は？')
    const q05Formula = blocks[q05Index]
    expect(q05Formula.type).toBe('formula')
    if (q05Formula.type === 'formula') {
      expect(q05Formula.parts).toEqual([
        { type: 'math', latex: 'B=-x^3+2x^2+' },
        { type: 'choice', itemId: 'n02-05' },
        { type: 'math', latex: '+2' },
      ])
      for (const part of q05Formula.parts) if (part.type === 'math') {
        expect(() => katex.renderToString(part.latex, { throwOnError: true })).not.toThrow()
      }
    }
    expect(isTextbookAnswerCorrect(q05, '0x')).toBe(true)
    expect(isTextbookAnswerCorrect(q05, '0')).toBe(false)
  })

  it('explains the distinction only AFTER Q05 so the placeholder answer is not leaked', () => {
    const earlier = JSON.stringify(blocks.slice(0, q05Index))
    expect(earlier).not.toContain('0x')
    expect(earlier).not.toContain('係数0')
    const explanation = blocks[q05Index + 1]
    expect(explanation.id).toBe('paragraph-n02-05-after')
    expect(JSON.stringify(explanation)).toContain('0x')
    expect(JSON.stringify(explanation)).toContain('係数は')
    const q06Index = blocks.findIndex(block =>
      (block.type === 'paragraph' || block.type === 'formula')
      && block.parts.some(part => part.type === 'choice' && part.itemId === 'n02-06'))
    expect(q06Index).toBeGreaterThan(q05Index + 1)
  })

  it('does not introduce a coefficient 1x or alter the existing 1→x display rule', () => {
    expect(section.items.map(q => q.answer).join(' ')).not.toContain('1x')
    expect(normalizeTextbookMath('x')).toBe('x')
    expect(normalizeTextbookMath('0x')).toBe('0x')
    expect(q05.choices).toContain('x')
  })
})
